heading: Penalties
lead: A person violating section 28301 of this title shall be fined under title 18, imprisoned not more than one year, or both.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2830245:66.Sept. 3, 5, 1916, ch. 436, § 4, 39 Stat. 722. The words “shall be guilty of a misdemeanor” are omitted, and the words “shall be fined under title 18” are substituted for “shall be fined not less than $100 and not more than $1,000”, for consistency with title 18. The words “upon conviction” are omitted as surplus.
